name: PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry Tbk
summary: PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry Tbk, together with its subsidiaries, offers tour and travel-related services in Indonesia. It operates through Travel and Retail Travel Shops segments. The company operates retail shops in Bali, Jakarta, Surabaya, Lombok, Medan, and Batam. It also sells tours and travel tickets; and handles related documents and tours. The company was formerly known as PT Sona Topas and changed its name to PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry Tbk in October 1990. PT Sona Topas Tourism Industry Tbk was incorporated in 1978 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia.
